main_text.p: ἐσθὴν μένειν.) Vtpote qui vestem forensem ha-beat vnicam : quod illiberale est planéque sordi-dum. Inde Ciceronis locus in Decianum quen-dam lepidissimus, in oratione pro L. Flacco, Ro-mam adiuenis:affers faciem nouam,nomen vetus,purpu-ram Tyriam, in qua tibi inuideo quod vnis vestimentis tandiu lautus es.
ἀλλὰ μισθώσῃ εἰς τὰς ἐξόδας.] Iuuenalis satyra sexta in Romanis mulieribus hanc notat illiberali-tatem simul & ambitionem,

p.i: Vt spectet ludos conducit Ogulnia vestem, / Conducit comites, sellam, cervical, amicas, / Nutricem, & flauam cui det mandata puellam.

main_text.p: Demosthenes Midiæ exprobrat quòd cùm esset præfectus equitum, alieno equo in pompæ trans-uectione vsus fuisset. Ἐξόδως accipe vt in illo, χαλε-πὴ γυναικῶν ἐξόδῳ, initio Lysistratæ. Raro olim matronæ pedem domo efferebát:nec in publicum nisi stiparæ gregibus ancillarum prodibant. Interdum ἐξόδῳ γυναικῶν dicitur de profectione ad ducendam pompam. vnde est apud Platonem in fine sexti De legibus, mulieb ris cuiusdam supplicij genus, μὴ μετέχειν τῆς ἐξόδων τῆς γυναικείων ἢ τιμῆς, ἢ τῆς εἰς τὰς γάμους, ἢ ἡλικίας παίδων φοιῆσεων. Lege Suidam in Αἰμιλία. Inde dictæ φιλέξοδοι γυναῖκες, quæ non sunt οἰκοποί & casariæ.

καὶ τὰς κλίνας ἐκνοπήσαι.) Hefychius qui τὸ κορεῖν etiam φθειρίζειν exponit, videtur hoc voluisse docere, eam vocem à κόεις deducatam interdum accipi pro cimices occidere, vel cimicibus lectos purgare, quod cimicare Latinis dicitur, vt pulicare. Græci, φθειρίζειν. Atque hæc interpretatio locum hîc ha-bere

page.notes: Greek passages are copied from the scan at small size and are doubtful in their accents and letters: "ἐσθὴν", "μισθώσῃ", "ἐξόδως", "χαλεπὴ", "φθειρίζειν" (second occurrence in the last paragraph, which may be a second word), "κλίνας", "ἐκνοπήσαι" and "φοιῆσεων" should be checked against the image. The Greek in the last paragraph after "Græci," may be misread. The verse lines were set as one stanza. The last line "bere" is the second half of the hyphenated word "habere". Long s has been normalised to s throughout.
